{{Quote|It is the final centuries of the Kymoodon Era. Brave Republic colonists are pushing beyond the galactic frontier, discovering new worlds where families can become farmers and homesteaders, building new lives for themselves far from the overcrowded city-worlds of the ancient Core.|[[Opening crawl]] for [[Episode XXIV: Death on the Rim|Episode XXIV: ''Death on the Rim'']] of the [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]] series ''[[True Tales of the Ancient Republic]]''|<ref name="TEGtWAC5">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-5-zenith-of-the-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 5: Zenith of the Republic}}</ref>}}
The '''Kymoodon Era''' was an era of time in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that started circa [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]] that marked a second boom in expansion similar to the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]]. [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] travel became more commonplace during this time and some of the most noted starship manufacturers noted this era as the time of their founding.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

In the last centuries of the era, [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] colonists spread beyond the frontier into what was then the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] between the Republic and [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. The Hutts sponsored numerous raids against these planets with the aim of [[Slavery/Legends|enslaving]] the colonists. [[Lexrul/Legends|Lexrul]], [[Drogheda/Legends|Drogheda]], [[Hathrox III|Hathrox]], [[Imram]] and [[Parcovey Minor]] were among those colonies targeted. The successful [[Assault on Parcovey Minor|defense of Parcovey Minor]] was one of the few bright spots for the colonists amid the raids. ''[[From Farm-Wife to Warrior]]'' was a contemporary account of [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] in the era.<ref name="TEGtWAC5" />

The Kymoodon Era stretched from the end of the [[Indecta Era]] in 15,000 BBY to the [[Pius Dea Era]], which began with the election of [[Contispex I/Legends|Contispex I]] as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] in [[11,987 BBY]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Timeline of this period==
*c. [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]]
**The Kymoodon Era begins.<ref name="TEA" />
**The [[Anomid/Legends|Anomids]] of [[Yablari/Legends|Yablari]] join the Republic.<ref name="UAC">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>
**The [[Hutt Cataclysms]] come to an end; by this time, the Hutt homeworld of [[Varl/Legends|Varl]] and the other colony worlds are lifeless wastes, forcing the Hutts to relocate to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Evocar]].<ref name="TEA" />
**The [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] heeds calls for the reestablishment of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
**The [[Cremlevian War]], which sees the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] conquer many of the planets in their galaxy before turning on themselves, comes to an end, and their homeworld [[Yuuzhan'tar]] strips the species of their ability to use the Force.<ref name="TNEGtAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>
**The [[Aquala/Legends|Aquala]] and [[Quara/Legends|Quara]] species fight a [[Aqualish Civil War|civil war]], but unite when an offworld exploratory vessel lands on [[Ando/Legends|Ando]]. The united [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] species kill the explorers and take their ship, learning to reproduce it.<ref name="TEGtAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>
**A few decades later, the Aqualish embark on a [[Aqualish–Republic War|campaign of conquest]], but are quickly stopped by the Republic.<ref name="TEGtAS" />
*[[14,743 BBY]]
**The [[Herglic Crush]] occurs; one of the casualties of the event is the [[Caliginous Automaton of Tomo-Reth|Caliginous Automaton]] on the planet [[Tomo-Reth]].<ref name="TEA" />
*c. [[14,500 BBY]]
**The [[Third Alsakan Conflict]] begins with the [[Commenor Run Campaign]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
*[[14,450 BBY]]
**The [[Cleansing of Rucapar]] occurs, a battle that sees the [[Alsakan Mosaics]] in the city of Rucapar destroyed by Republic forces.<ref name="TEGtW" />
*[[14,300 BBY]]
**The Third Alsakan Conflict comes to an end; during the final stages of fighting, the [[Duros Red Credit Brigade]] is [[Battle of Raxus Prime (Third Alsakan Conflict)|defeated]].<ref name="TEA" />
**[[Nikato's Bootheel]] is established around the planet [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]].<ref name="TEA" />
*c. [[14,000 BBY]]
**A number of Sith establish a [[library-temple]] on the world of [[Krayiss II|Krayiss Two]] where they slumber and their [[Force ghost/Legends|spirits]] haunt the temple for the next 10,000 years.<ref name="Tale Dark Side">{{WEGCite|story=A Tale from the Dark Side|book=Tales of the Jedi Companion}}</ref>
**The [[House Korden|Korden family]] first appears.<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref>
*c. [[13,800 BBY]]
*[[13,649 BBY]]
**The [[Defence of Drogheda]] takes place.<ref name="TEGtW" />
*[[13,220 BBY]]
**The [[Conquest of Manaan]] occurs.<ref name="TEGtW" />
*c. [[13,200 BBY]]
**The Fourth Alsakan Conflict comes to an end.<ref name="TEGtW" />
*c. [[13,050 BBY]]
**The [[Fifth Alsakan Conflict]] begins.<ref name="TEGtW" />
*c. [[13,000 BBY]]
**The [[Herglic Trade Empire]] joins the Republic, sparking development around the [[Hidakai Pool]] route.<ref name="TEA" />
**The planet [[Ailon/Legends|Ailon]] becomes a member of the Republic.<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>
*[[12,980 BBY]]
**[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Hirken]] defends Alsakani colonies in the Northern Dependencies, a campaign that was a major turning point in the conflict.<ref name="TEGtW" />
*c. [[12,700 BBY]]
**The [[Resistance on Cyrillia]] occurs.<ref name="TEGtW" />
**The Fifth Alsakan Conflict comes to an end.<ref name="TEGtW" />
*c. [[12,293 BBY]]
**An expedition led by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Beramsh]] conducts the first surveys of the planet [[Tandun III]].<ref name="Millennium">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>
*c. [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]]
**Ithorian herdships make first contact with the Republic.<ref name="TEA" />
**The planet [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] is settled by explorers and colonists from Corellia, and the planet becomes an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] that later serves as a basis for the [[Great Northern Crusade|Seventh Pius Dea Crusade]].<ref name="TEA" />
**Starting from the planet [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]], scouts start to establish the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']] route, bridging the gap between the Republic and Hutt Space.<ref name="TEA" />
**[[Haddius Korden]], a successful merchant from [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], turned his family business into [[Korden Outfitting and Surveying]], which supplied a wide variety of equipment to colonists headed for the farthest frontiers of the known galaxy.<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue" />
*[[11,987 BBY]]
**[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Pers'lya]] is impeached by the [[Pius Dea]], a religious sect who install the Human adherent [[Contispex I/Legends|Contispex]]. Contispex's election begins the [[Pius Dea Era]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
